title: Your own writing
lead: Draft your real messages, emails or texts in your own words, before asking anyone else to.
empty: No drafts yet. Think of the next message you need to write and start here.
draftTitleHint: For example: "Email to the landlord about the repair".
bodyHint: No pasting here: it all comes from you. Fix mistakes later.
bodyHintPasteOn: Pasting is allowed in Settings. Use it only if you need it to dictate.
pasteBlocked: This is for writing by hand. If you need to paste to dictate or for accessibility, turn it on in Settings.
compareLead: If you like, ask an AI for a version on your own and paste it here. What matters is deciding what you keep from yours.
keepLabel: What would you keep from yours?
keepHint: A phrase, a tone, an idea the AI didn't have.
